toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both halves have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma before 'en' is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma before the concessive 'al'-clause aids reading and matches 'Anders bly die pad oop, al raak hulle.' later in the lesson.
toegepas.fout: no comma before the concessive al-clause, inconsistent with the same construction later in the lesson
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma separates main and subordinate clause, aids a first reading and matches 'oop, al raak hulle'.

toegepas.voor: Dit is 'n geslote stroombaan en die lampie brand.
toegepas.na: Dit is 'n geslote stroombaan, en die lampie brand.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two full clauses joined by 'en'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit is ...' and 'die lampie brand' each have their own subject and verb, so the comma is required.

toegepas.voor: Dit is 'n oop stroombaan en die lampie is dood.
toegepas.na: Dit is 'n oop stroombaan, en die lampie brand nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'is dood' is colloquial for a lamp; 'brand nie' is standard and mirrors 'die lampie brand' in the closed case; also adds the AWS comma.
toegepas.fout: 'die lampie is dood' is colloquial and missing the AWS comma
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'brand nie' is standard, mirrors the closed case exactly, keeps the meaning and adds the required comma.

toegepas.voor: Dit is vinniger om te teken as prente van die regte dele.
toegepas.na: Dit is vinniger om te teken as om prente van die regte dele te maak.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The comparison is incomplete: 'om te teken as prente' compares an action with a thing.
toegepas.fout: 'om te teken as prente' can be misread as 'draw as pictures' and compares an action with a thing
toegepas.rede_keurder: Completing the comparison with 'as om prente ... te maak' removes the stumble without changing what is compared.

toegepas.voor: al is die regte drade krom
toegepas.na: al is die werklike drade krom
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'regte' next to 'reguit lyne' can be read as 'straight' (a 'regte lyn' is a straight line); 'werklike' is unambiguous.
toegepas.fout: 'regte' beside 'reguit lyne met hoeke' can read as 'straight' or evoke 'regte hoeke'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'werklike' says 'the actual wires' unambiguously, with the same meaning.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans compounds are written as one word; no hyphen is needed here.
toegepas.fout: compound written with an unneeded hyphen
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans writes the compound 'selsimbole' as one word; there is no vowel clash to justify the hyphen.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'los 'n gaping' calques English 'leaves a gap'; Afrikaans says 'laat 'n gaping'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'laat 'n gaping' is the standard Afrikaans expression and keeps the meaning.

laat_vaar.voor: In Graad 5 het jy 'n lampie laat brand met 'n sel en twee drade.
laat_vaar.na: In Graad 5 het jy met 'n sel en twee drade 'n lampie laat brand.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The means phrase sits more naturally before the object and verb cluster in Afrikaans.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Placing the means phrase after the verb cluster is natural spoken Afrikaans; the reorder is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'lê gestoor' is a slightly stiff combination; the plain passive is clearer for Grade 6.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Daarin le die energie gestoor' reads naturally and links to the previous sentence; the passive only reads differently.

laat_vaar.voor: en weer terug na die sel
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'weer terug' is pleonastic; 'terug' already carries the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'en weer terug' is an idiomatic Afrikaans expression, not a fault; dropping 'weer' is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: wat aan mekaar kan raak en weer kan wegbeweeg
laat_vaar.na: wat mekaar kan raak en weer van mekaar kan wegbeweeg
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'mekaar raak' matches the next sentence, and 'wegbeweeg' needs 'van mekaar' to say what the parts move away from.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'aan mekaar raak' is correct Afrikaans and 'wegbeweeg' is clear in context; the proposal only lengthens the sentence.

laat_vaar.voor: twee reguit lyne langs mekaar met die een langer as die ander
laat_vaar.na: twee reguit lyne langs mekaar, waarvan een langer as die ander is
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'met die een langer as die ander' is a loose, English-like absolute construction; a relative clause reads more naturally.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'met die een langer as die ander' is a natural Afrikaans construction; the relative clause is longer and no clearer in a list item.

vlae.teks: In 'n geslote diagram loop die lyn dus sonder 'n gaping
vlae.rede: 'n geslote diagram' is loose shorthand for 'the diagram of a closed circuit'; spelling it out would push the sentence to about 27 words, so it is left for the reviewer or writer to judge.
